r02.

Premise correction: no per-user API rate-limiting middleware is registered, so there are no per-user request limits. The server registers only recovery and CORS middleware in `server/server.go`; API v1 registers authentication middleware/interceptors in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`. The 256 MiB setting there is a request-body size limit, not a rate limit.
